<function=run_cmd>

# Remediation is applicable only in certain platforms if rpm --quiet -q kernel-core; then cat > /etc/fapolicyd/rules.d/99-deny-everything.rules << EOF
# Red Hat KCS 7003854 (https://access.redhat.com/solutions/7003854)
deny perm=any all : all

chmod 644 /etc/fapolicyd/rules.d/99-deny-everything.rules

else

fi
# make sure file has newline at the end
</parameter>
</function>
